questions.question: In which state is Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the **Adilabad district** of Telangana.
 
• The sanctuary spans an area of approximately **893 square kilometers**.
 
• It was declared a wildlife sanctuary in **1965** to protect its rich biodiversity and wildlife.
 
• Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary is known for its population of **tigers, leopards, and deer**.
 
• In 2012, it was designated as a **Tiger Reserve** under Project Tiger to ensure better conservation efforts for the tiger population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Project Tiger**

 
 
• It is a tiger conservation program launched in India in **1973**.
 
• The aim is to protect tigers from extinction by ensuring a viable population in their natural habitats.
 
• Project Tiger focuses on habitat preservation, anti-poaching measures, and scientific management.
 
• India has over **50 tiger reserves** under this project, covering various regions across the country.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity Hotspot**
 
 
• A biodiversity hotspot is a biogeographic region with a significant reservoir of biodiversity that is under threat from humans.
 
• To qualify as a biodiversity hotspot, a region must contain at least **1,500 species of vascular plants** as endemics.
 
• It must have lost at least **70% of its original habitat**.
 
• The Eastern Himalayas and Western Ghats in India are examples of biodiversity hotspots.
 
 
 
• **Wildlife Sanctuary**
 
 
• A wildlife sanctuary is a protected area reserved for the conservation of wild animals and their habitats.
 
• Human activities such as cultivation, grazing, and forestry are regulated to ensure minimal disturbance to wildlife.
 
• India has over **500 wildlife sanctuaries**, each focusing on preserving different species and ecosystems.
 
• Examples include Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary, Jim Corbett National Park, and Kaziranga National Park.
 
 
 
• **Ecotourism**
 
 
• Ecotourism is a form of sustainable travel that supports the conservation of natural environments.
 
• It aims to minimize the negative impact on the environment and local communities.
 
• Ecotourism promotes responsible travel practices, environmental education, and cultural awareness.
 
• Popular ecotourism destinations in India include Periyar National Park, Sunderbans, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

questions.question: The Guindy National Park is located in which state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Guindy National Park** is located in the state of **Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• It is situated in the capital city, **Chennai**, and is one of the smallest national parks in India, covering an area of approximately **2.70 square kilometers**.
 
• The park is home to a rich diversity of flora and fauna, including species like **spotted deer, blackbucks, and jackals**.
 
• Guindy National Park also houses a famous **Children’s Park** and a **Snake Park**, making it a popular destination for education and recreation.
 
• It is one of the few national parks located in the heart of a metropolitan city, providing a green refuge amidst urbanization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of Guindy National Park**

 
 
• The park was originally part of the grounds of the **Raj Bhavan**, the official residence of the Governor of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It was declared a reserved forest in **1910** and later designated as a national park in **1978**.
 
 
 
• **Flora in the Park**
 
 
• The park’s vegetation is predominantly **dry evergreen scrub**, a rare type of forest found in South India.
 
• It also includes grasslands and over **350 species of plants** such as shrubs, climbers, and trees.
 
 
 
• **Fauna in the Park**
 
 
• The park supports over **150 species of birds**, including parakeets, koels, and flycatchers.
 
• It is also home to reptiles like **cobras, monitor lizards, and turtles**, along with amphibians and insects.
 
 
 
• **Other Attractions**
 
 
• The **Snake Park** inside Guindy National Park showcases a variety of snakes and reptiles and is managed by the Madras Crocodile Bank Trust.
 
• The **Children’s Park** features mini-zoos and play areas, making it a family-friendly location.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Efforts**
 
 
• The park plays a crucial role in the **conservation of endangered species** like the blackbuck.
 
• It also serves as a hub for **environmental education** and awareness programs for schools and the public.

questions.question: In which of the following states is the Panna National Park located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Panna National Park was established in 1981.
 
• It is located in the Panna and Chhatarpur districts of Madhya Pradesh in India.
 
• It was declared in 1994 as the twenty-second Tiger reserve of India and the fifth in Madhya Pradesh, 
 
• It was given the Award of Excellence in 2007 as the best-maintained national park of India by the Ministry of Tourism of India.
 
• Ken river drains through the National Park.
 
• It houses a reptile park.
 
• Panna was recognized as the 18th biosphere reserve in the year 2011 by the government of India.
 
• Panna was granted biosphere reserve status by UNESCO in November 2020 under the MAB program.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

questions.question: In which state of India is Kaziranga National Park located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kaziranga National Park** is located in the state of **Assam** in India.
 
• It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its significant population of the **Indian one-horned rhinoceros**.
 
• The park spans an area of approximately **430 square kilometers** and is characterized by its diverse flora and fauna.
 
• It is also home to large populations of **tigers, elephants, wild water buffalo, and swamp deer**.
 
• Kaziranga is recognized for its efforts in **conservation and protection of wildlife**, making it a prominent national park in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Assam is located in the northeastern part of India, known for its rich biodiversity and natural beauty.
 
• The state is bordered by Bhutan and Arunachal Pradesh to the north, Nagaland and Manipur to the east, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram, and Bangladesh to the south, and West Bengal to the west.
 
• Assam is also famous for its tea plantations, silk, and the Brahmaputra River, which flows through the state.
 
• The state capital of Assam is **Dispur**, located within the city of Guwahati.

Gir forest in Gujarat has the Asiatic Lion.

questions.question: The Betul, Hoshangabad and Chhindwara districts of Madhya Pradesh is a part of which of the following Biosphere Reserves?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pachmarhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pachmarhi Biosphere Reserve is located in Madhya Pradesh and includes Betul, Hoshangabad, and Chhindwara districts.
 
• It was established in **1999** by the Government of India to conserve biodiversity and promote sustainable development.
 
• The Pachmarhi Biosphere Reserve is a part of the Satpura range, which is known for its unique flora and fauna.
 
• This reserve is home to several endangered species, including the Indian giant squirrel and flying squirrel.
 
• Pachmarhi Biosphere Reserve is also recognized under the UNESCO Man and Biosphere (MAB) Programme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biosphere Reserves in India:**

 
 
• Biosphere reserves are specially designated areas for the conservation of biodiversity, research, and sustainable development.
 
• India has **18 Biosphere Reserves**, including Nilgiri, Sundarbans, Gulf of Mannar, and Nanda Devi.
 
• Ten of these reserves are part of UNESCO’s World Network of Biosphere Reserves.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO Man and Biosphere Programme:**
 
 
• It is an intergovernmental scientific program launched in 1971 to improve the relationship between people and their environment.
 
• The program emphasizes sustainable development, conservation of biodiversity, and scientific research.
 
 
 
• **Satpura Range:**
 
 
• The Satpura range is a prominent mountain range in central India, spanning Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Chhattisgarh.
 
• It is rich in biodiversity, containing several forests, wildlife sanctuaries, and national parks.
 
 
 
• **Endangered Species in Pachmarhi Biosphere Reserve:**
 
 
• The reserve is home to endangered species like the Indian giant squirrel, leopard, and Indian pangolin.
 
• Efforts are made to protect these species and their habitats through conservation programs.

questions.question: The Blackbuck National Park is located in _______
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Gujarat__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Blackbuck National Park is located in Gujarat.
 
• The sanctuary was established in July 1976, as an initial protected area of about 18 sq km.
 
• In 1980, another 16 sq km were added to increase the total area to 34 sq km.
 
• The park is surrounded Gulf of Khambhat on the south and by wastelands and agriculture fields on the other sides.
 
• It was the grassland of the Maharaja of the princely state of Bhavnagar.
 
• The National park has been classified as a 4B Gujarat-Rajwada biotic province of a semi-arid bio-geographical zone.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Gir National Park.
 
• Marine National Park.
 
• Jambughoda Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
• Barda Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
• Purna Wildlife Sanctuary.

questions.question: The Indravati National Park is located in which state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Indravati National Park is located in the state of **Chhattisgarh**, India.
 
• It is situated in the Bijapur district and is a part of the **Dandakaranya region**.
 
• Indravati National Park is renowned for being one of the prime habitats of the endangered species **Indian Wild Buffalo (Bubalus arnee)**.
 
• The park is named after the **Indravati River**, which flows through the area.
 
• Declared a National Park in **1981**, it later became a Tiger Reserve under the Project Tiger initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Wild Buffalo:**

 
 
• The Indian Wild Buffalo is listed as **endangered** by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
 
• Its population has been declining due to habitat loss, poaching, and interbreeding with domestic buffaloes.
 
• Indravati National Park is considered one of the last strongholds of this species.
 
 
 
• **Project Tiger:**
 
 
• Launched in **1973**, Project Tiger aims to conserve India's tiger population and its habitats.
 
• Indravati National Park was included in Project Tiger in **1983** to protect its rich biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Flora and Fauna of Indravati National Park:**
 
 
• The park is home to diverse wildlife, including species like leopards, sloth bears, sambar deer, and barking deer.
 
• It features tropical moist and dry deciduous forests, dominated by teak and sal trees.
 
 
 
• **Indravati River:**
 
 
• The Indravati River is a tributary of the **Godavari River**.
 
• It plays a crucial role in supporting the ecosystem of the national park.

questions.question: Which of the following Biosphere reserves is located in Uttarakhand?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nanda Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **Uttarakhand**, India.
 
• This biosphere reserve is centered around the **Nanda Devi National Park**, which is a UNESCO **World Heritage Site**.
 
• The reserve is known for its **rich biodiversity** and includes a variety of **flora and fauna**, many of which are endemic to the region.
 
• The geographical area of the reserve is characterized by **steep mountain peaks**, deep valleys, and glaciers, including the famous **Nanda Devi Peak**.
 
• The reserve is part of the **Western Himalayan biogeographical zone**, which is crucial for the conservation of various endangered species.
 
• It is home to species such as the **snow leopard**, **Himalayan musk deer**, and various high-altitude plants.
 
• The **Government of India** designated Nanda Devi as a biosphere reserve under its **Man and Biosphere Programme** initiated by UNESCO.
 
• This reserve also plays a significant role in preserving the **cultural heritage** of the indigenous communities residing in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Panchmarhi Biosphere Reserve**__

 __
 
• **Panchmarhi Biosphere Reserve** is located in **Madhya Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is known for its **unique landscapes** and diverse ecosystems, including forests, waterfalls, and caves.
 
• This reserve includes the **Satpura National Park**, **Bori Wildlife Sanctuary**, and **Panchmarhi Sanctuary**.
 
• The region is rich in **flora and fauna**, including species like leopards, Indian bison, and various birds.
 
 
 
• **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve**__
 __
 
• The **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve** spans the states of **Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala** in southern India.
 
• It is part of the **Western Ghats**, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• The reserve is known for its **high biodiversity** and is home to species like the **Nilgiri Tahr** and **Lion-tailed Macaque**.
 
• It includes protected areas such as the **Bandipur National Park**, **Mudumalai Wildlife Sanctuary**, and **Silent Valley National Park**.
 
 
 
• **Dihang-Dibang Biosphere Reserve**__
 
 
• **Dihang-Dibang Biosphere Reserve** is situated in the state of **Arunachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• The reserve is named after the **Dihang and Dibang rivers** that flow through the region.
 
• It is known for its **pristine wilderness** and includes dense forests, high-altitude meadows, and diverse wildlife.
 
• Rare species such as the **red panda** and **Mishmi takin** are found here.
